Dear PL2030 team,

I am writing to apply for the six-month traineeship at Public Libraries 2030, as advertised on EuroBrussels. The chance to support your work on EU projects, advocacy and communications — and to help Europe's 65,000 public libraries tackle societal challenges — is exactly the kind of hands-on immersion I am looking for.

My background combines digital communications, web management and content creation. As a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist, I build and maintain websites, write and publish content, and use analytics to track results. I also work as a junior digital marketer, managing CMS content and social media integration for client sites. I am fluent in English, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking initiative in a small team.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to PL2030's communications and events, and to learn from your team in Brussels. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear PL2030 team,

I am writing to apply for the six-month professional immersion traineeship at Public Libraries 2030, as advertised on EuroBrussels. The opportunity to support your small team across EU projects, advocacy events and communications — and to help Europe's 65,000 public libraries address big societal challenges — is one I would embrace with energy and curiosity.

My experience sits at the intersection of digital communications, web management and content. As a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist, I design, build and run websites, write and publish content, and use analytics to measure what works. In my current role as a junior digital marketer, I manage CMS content for client sites, handle on-page SEO and keyword research, and integrate social media. I have also built and maintained a website for a pharmacists' association with around 600 member profile pages, which taught me the value of consistent, well-organised content and careful attention to detail.

What draws me to PL2030 is the chance to apply these skills in a European policy context. I am fluent in English, proactive and organised, and I enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. I am comfortable with Canva, WordPress and Mailchimp, and I learn new tools quickly. The structured training plan and dedicated mentor are particularly appealing, as I am eager to take on responsibility and grow within a small, mission-driven team.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your communications, events and research, and to learn from your work in Brussels. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
• Fluent English and native Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level — strong written and spoken communication for a multilingual Brussels office.
• Hands-on communications and content experience: SEO writing, blog and website content management, social media integration, and newsletter tools like Mailchimp.
• Proficient in WordPress, Canva and CMS platforms — directly relevant to PL2030's communications and website tasks.
• Organised and detail-oriented: managed consistent layouts for ~600 member profile pages and ran technical audits with measurable results.
• Proactive and flexible: freelance and remote work experience, comfortable taking initiative and working both independently and in a small team.
